newsitem.title: USA: Arrest warrant issued for actor Culkin's father.
newsitem.headline: Arrest warrant issued for actor Culkin's father.

text.p: A judge issued an arrest warrant Monday for the father of "Home Alone" star Macaulay Culkin for failing to show up in court to answer assault charges stemming from a brawl with a photographer last month.
Christopher "Kit" Culkin, 51, is accused of punching a news photographer who tried to take his picture on March 4 outside his West 60th Street apartment building.
The alleged attack occurred the same day a judge took financial control away from the child actor's parents and gave it to an accountant.
Police gave Culkin a so-called desk appearance ticket, charging him with criminal mischief, attempted assault and harassment.
Andy Uzzle, the New York Post photographer who filed the police report, claimed Culkin grabbed him around the neck and punched him in the face, leaving him with blurred vision in one eye.

Last week, Culkin's mother, Patricia Brentrup, won custody of the child actor and his brothers and sister as well as control of his $17 million fortune. Culkin and Brentrup, who never married, had seven children.

In the custody ruling, the judge called the elder Culkin "a demanding, difficult and pugnacious man." He is considered in Hollywood to be difficult to deal with, making major demands on producers and directors on behalf of his children.
During the custody battle, Brentrup accused Culkin of excessive drinking and physical abuse. He accused her of allowing their children to run wild.
